lines.zh: 盾沿压低，我按队列迈步。
lines.en: Shield rim low, I step in time with the rank.
Gladius at my thigh, I march faster.
Hobnails crunch gravel in even rhythm.

lines.zh: 我跟着军旗，不快也不慢。
lines.en: I follow the standard, neither fast nor slow.

lines.zh: 三步一停，保持横排不散。
lines.en: Three steps, a pause; the rank stays unbroken.

lines.zh: 盾面朝前，肩头微微前倾。
lines.en: Shield forward, shoulders leaning in.

lines.zh: 这身十三点护甲，走久了闷。
lines.en: Thirteen points of armor gets stuffy on the march.

lines.zh: 我数着同伴的脚步声前进。
lines.en: I march to the beat of my comrades' boots.

lines.zh: 前排慢下来，我立刻补上。
lines.en: The front rank slows; I close the gap at once.
Stepping over roots without tilting the shield.

lines.zh: 罗马的步子，量过才走得远。
lines.en: Roman paces are measured to go the distance.

lines.zh: 我边走边把剑鞘往后推。
lines.en: Walking, I push the scabbard back out of the way.
Even standing still, the shield stays steady.
I keep my eyes on the open ground ahead.
A long grip on the hilt leaves my palm damp.
The line cannot slack; I straighten my back.

lines.zh: 风吹过盔缨，我眨了下眼。
lines.en: Wind through the crest makes me blink.

lines.zh: 我在等号声，等得脚发麻。
lines.en: Waiting for the horn, my feet go numb.

lines.zh: 盾心的铜扣被我擦得发亮。
lines.en: I have polished the bronze boss bright.

lines.zh: 前面的同伴没动，我也不动。
lines.en: My comrade does not move, so neither do I.

lines.zh: 这口气要压住，不能先喘。
lines.en: I hold my breath; I will not pant first.

lines.zh: 我悄悄把重心换到另一条腿。
lines.en: Quietly I shift my weight to the other leg.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，我看见你的手。
lines.en: You stand too close; I can see your hands.

lines.zh: 我抬高视线，掂量你的甲。
lines.en: I raise my eyes and weigh your armor.
Friend or foe, give me your name.
I square the shield to face you.

lines.zh: 你比我高，可短剑不看身高。
lines.en: You are taller, but a gladius ignores height.
I'm gauging how long your sword is.

lines.zh: 盾沿压得很低，只露眼睛。
lines.en: My shield rim low, only my eyes show.

lines.zh: 我举盾的手，已经发麻了。
lines.en: The arm behind my shield has gone numb.
I turn the hilt in my grip.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我脾气不太好。
lines.en: Do not come nearer; my temper is short.

lines.zh: 我闷哼一声，把盾抬回来。
lines.en: I grunt and lift the shield back up.

lines.zh: 这一下打穿了我的甲缝。
lines.en: That one found the seam in my armor.
I give half a step, but I do not fall.
It hurts, but I can stand.
I grit my teeth and grip the sword.
Blood seeps out from under the plates.
I will remember that blow.
I take a breath and raise the shield again.

lines.zh: 队列里没人退，我也不退。
lines.en: Nobody in the rank falls back; neither will I.

lines.zh: 我按着伤口，眼睛没离开你。
lines.en: I press the wound, eyes still on you.

lines.zh: 面包的味，我隔着头盔闻到了。
lines.en: I smell bread right through the helmet.

lines.zh: 军粮分完了，你手里那袋是什么？
lines.en: Rations are gone; what is in that sack?
Hold on, let me take one bite first.

lines.zh: 热的食物，比军粮强太多。
lines.en: Hot food beats field rations by far.
I lower the shield a notch.
My stomach is louder than the horn.
Just one bite, I promise only one.
The smell of roast makes me shift my feet.

lines.zh: 短剑换到左手，我再伸手。
lines.en: I shift my gladius to my left hand and reach again.
A full belly is what lifts a shield.

lines.zh: 撞上我的盾，你退半步吧。
lines.en: Bump my shield and you take half a step back.

lines.zh: 别把肩顶在我的甲片上。
lines.en: Do not push your shoulder into my plates.

lines.zh: 我们挤成一排，谁也过不去。
lines.en: We are packed rank to rank; nobody passes.

lines.zh: 盾面顶住你，脚钉在土里。
lines.en: My shield stops you, feet planted in the dirt.
Steady, do not tread on my hobnails.

lines.zh: 盾面响了一声，还是没歪。
lines.en: The shield rings once and stays true.
You nearly knocked me out of the rank.

lines.zh: 十三点护甲不是白穿的。
lines.en: Thirteen points of armor earn their keep.
I fill the empty slot behind you.
Move aside; I still have to rejoin the line.

lines.zh: 这种事，等服役期满再说。
lines.en: That sort of thing waits until my service ends.
My betrothal waits outside Rome's walls.
Not in camp; stand properly.

lines.zh: 同伴在看着，别让我难做。
lines.en: My comrades are watching; do not put me in a spot.
One horn call and I am back in the line.
I cannot even leave the camp gate.
This armor does not come off lightly.
Let the war end first, then we talk.

lines.zh: 我心里只有队列和军旗。
lines.en: My heart holds only the rank and the standard.
Stop laughing; I am serious.

lines.zh: 这东西掉在地上，我捡起来。
lines.en: It fell to the ground, so I pick it up.
The quartermaster will log this one.
Whose weapon is this? I will hold it.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时把盾竖在身前。
lines.en: I bend down with the shield planted in front.

lines.zh: 剑归鞘，手上还能拿东西。
lines.en: Sword sheathed, my hand is free for this.
It is not mine, but I pick it up anyway.
Short sword in hand, shield forward.

lines.zh: 掉在这儿的，都算战利品。
lines.en: What lies here counts as spoils.
I lift it and weigh it in my hand.
I sheath my gladius and bend to pick it up.

lines.zh: 目标出现在我的盾线里。
lines.en: A target has entered my shield line.
You will do; hold still.
I have you marked; do not think of circling.
One stride into gladius range.
I press the shield forward half a block.
My scutum rises, half my face showing.

lines.zh: 号角没响，我也知道该打谁。
lines.en: No horn needed; I know who to fight.
My eyes will not leave you now.
You stepped into my post.
The rank moves forward, aimed at you.

lines.zh: 我拔剑的声音就是信号。
lines.en: The sound of my draw is the signal.
Do not run; I can catch you.
I choose you because you are nearest.
This fight should start now.

lines.zh: 我的盾已经挡住你的退路。
lines.en: My shield has closed your way back.
Locked on; count one.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚步调整方向。
lines.en: I track your steps and shift my angle.
You go left; my shield follows.

lines.zh: 我不急，短剑要贴身才快。
lines.en: I wait; a gladius is quickest up close.
How much strength do you have left?
I am counting the gaps between your swings.
You switched hands; I noticed.
My eyes follow only you.

lines.zh: 往后一步，我就再压一步。
lines.en: Step back and I press one step further.
You are hunting for a gap in me.
The gap is behind the shield, out of reach.

lines.zh: 短剑在手，呼吸先慢下来。
lines.en: Gladius in hand — breath slows first.
The higher you raise it, the slower it falls.
I herd you toward my comrades.
Your way out is narrowing.
I keep watching your shoulder.
Shoulder moves, blade follows.
Patience is a Roman weapon.
Move first, and I will have my answer.
We hold half a step apart.
You do not strike; neither do I.
The gladius stabs at your ribs.
I bash your wrist with the shield rim.
One step in, the point follows.
The shield goes first; the blade follows.
This one aims at the seam in your armor.
I stab, then give half a step.
The blade slips out past the shield edge.

lines.zh: 我压住你的武器，再出手。
lines.en: I pin your weapon, then strike.
Shield to chest, blade to throat.
A gladius does not swing; it is pushed forward.
You guard high; I go low.

lines.zh: 我用全身的重量压进去。
lines.en: I drive in with my whole weight.
You barely dodge that thrust.

lines.zh: 盾一顶，剑从你腰侧进去。
lines.en: Shield shoves; the blade goes in at your waist.

lines.zh: 剑锋擦着你的护甲滑开。
lines.en: The point skids off your armor.

lines.zh: 我连续两下，第二下更低。
lines.en: Two strikes, and the second goes lower.
The shield face eats your counter.

lines.zh: 我贴近到你能闻到铁锈。
lines.en: I close in until you smell rust.
The rank taught me this one.
Recover the blade, then thrust again.
I step out from behind the standard.

lines.zh: 队列空了第一个位置，我填上。
lines.en: The first gap in the line is mine to fill.
Hobnails hit the ground; Rome has arrived.
I settle the plates on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 新兵看好了，这才叫站位。
lines.en: Watch, recruit; this is how you hold a post.
Shield up, and I am counted present.

lines.zh: 这地方没军旗，我照样站。
lines.en: No standard here, and I stand anyway.
The air here smells unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 我从锻炉边直接走进战场。
lines.en: I walk from the forge straight to the fight.

lines.zh: 剑是刚打出来的，还带热气。
lines.en: The blade is fresh from the anvil, still warm.

lines.zh: 十三点护甲，压得我肩膀沉。
lines.en: Thirteen points of armor weigh my shoulders down.

lines.zh: 我数了数这里的人，太少了。
lines.en: I count the people here; far too few.

lines.zh: 火燎到甲片，烫得我松了手。
lines.en: Fire licks the plates and I nearly drop my grip.

lines.zh: 落地时膝盖一软，我撑住了。
lines.en: My knees buckle on landing, but I hold.

lines.zh: 水灌进头盔，我胡乱往上蹬。
lines.en: Water fills my helmet; I kick blindly upward.

lines.zh: 爆风把我连盾一起掀翻。
lines.en: The blast flips me over along with the shield.

lines.zh: 盾牌举起来，短剑才拔得出。
lines.en: Shield up, then the gladius comes out.

lines.zh: 光打在我盾上，手一阵发麻。
lines.en: Light hits my shield and my arm goes numb.

lines.zh: 军粮断了三天，我握不住剑。
lines.en: Three days without rations; I can barely hold the sword.

lines.zh: 雷顺着剑尖烧到我手臂。
lines.en: Lightning runs down the blade into my arm.

lines.zh: 脚下一空，我连甲一起往下坠。
lines.en: The ground vanishes and I fall in full armor.
